title: Derive stable, perceptually distinguishable colors from strings
abstract: Establish a deterministic string-to-color mapping suitable for assigning stable color identities to objects. Prioritize human perceptual separation and accessible contrast. Examine relevant methods used by Chromalect and the ChatGPT Signal project before standardizing an algorithm.
unresolved: Reference implementations have not been inspected; algorithm selection is deferred.
Absolute uniqueness for unbounded strings in a finite color space is impossible; later processing must define collision and contrast policy.
